# GET /api/v1/admin/cron

Lists all registered cron tasks with their schedule and execution info

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer (token with AccessTokenScopeCategoryAdmin) · **ID:** `ep-110`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| page | query | integer | False |
| limit | query | integer | False |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**200** — []Cron

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `name` | string | Task name |
| `schedule` | string | Cron schedule expression |
| `next` | time.Time | Next scheduled execution |
| `prev` | time.Time | Previous execution time |
| `exec_times` | int64 | Total execution count |

- **403** — Non-admin user

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | admin.ListCronTasks | controller | Call cron.ListTasks() to get all tasks from scheduler; Get list options for pagination; Paginate in-memory slice with util.PaginateSlice; Convert TaskTableRow to structs.Cron |
| 2 | [services](../modules/services.md) | cron.ListTasks | service | Get all jobs from gocron scheduler; Build map of job name to job; Lock tasks mutex; For each registered task, get schedule/next/prev from scheduler; Return TaskTable with all task info |
